lines:
X01#0   caught (auto)  [high] enclosure open: the palisade runs only across the front (one straight wall through the gatehouse); no wall behind the far row of houses or along the right-hand row: the village is not enclosed, houses back straight onto the forest
          note [high] The palisade protects only the foreground side; north/east house backs face open forest with no closing ring. The plan itself leaves these sides unclosed, so this topology originates upstream.

X02#0   caught (auto)  [medium] coat back split inconsistent across views: the BACK view shows a centre-back split (slit) in her coat between the legs, but the FRONT view, looking through between her legs to the coat's back, shows no split
          note [medium] The coat's centre-back split visible in BACK is missing in FRONT: between the calves the rear coat forms a continuous dark panel instead of the opening visible in the back view.

X03#0   MISSED ?       [high] second palisade inside the village: the gate is a gap between two wall runs in the foreground, and the square beyond has its own ring/second wall; the near palisade cuts across the square
X03#1   MISSED ?       [high] duplicate person: two Branns (one standing, one bowing)

X03#2   caught (auto)  [high] second gatehouse/tower at the back of the square (master has one gatehouse)
          note [high] A second gatehouse/tower appears across the square beyond the open foreground gate, contradicting the single gatehouse layout.

X05#0   caught (auto)  [high] double parapet: two parallel low walls a metre apart in the foreground (plus the far parapet): there should be one roof-edge parapet to sit on
          note [high] Two separate parallel parapets run across the foreground a step apart; this duplicates the wall Granny and Suna will sit on.

X06#0   caught (auto)  [medium] Maren far too big for the set: walk camera at 1.6 m eye height puts the horizon at about the far snow line through the arch (y~485), but her eyes are at y~330 with feet at y~600, so she is about 3.5 m tall; she is as tall as the palisade and taller than the gate arch she stands just in front of
          note [high] Maren is giant-sized for the plate: her eyes sit roughly half a body height above the road horizon, and her body exceeds the nearby gate opening despite being only slightly nearer the camera.

X07#0   caught (auto)  [high] side view: bare greatsword floats behind her with a gap; nothing (strap, scabbard, hand) holds it
          note [high] SIDE sword hangs behind her back with an uninterrupted strip of background between blade and body and no visible scabbard or fastening to hold it.

X07#1   caught (auto)  [medium] views disagree: bare blade in front/side views, a brown scabbard on a strap only in the back view
          note [medium] The greatsword/scabbard changes length and covering: BACK has a brown sheath ending around mid-thigh, while SIDE is a bare steel blade and the front reference sword reaches the calf.

X08#0   caught (auto)  [high] beat contradicted: Maren reaches out with both hands to take the pouch (script: she does not move, does not take it)
          note [high] Maren reaches both hands toward and under the offered pouch, acting to accept it instead of staying still with her eyes on Brann.

X10#0   caught (auto)  [high] three different gates for one gatehouse: master/P01/C1 a timber tower over a double gate; C2/C4 a plain plank door in the palisade; C6 open posts with no tower
          note [medium] The same gatehouse changes architecture: master has one square hipped-roof two-storey tower, P01 adds a gabled gate portal and a separate tall building, and C1 changes it again.

X11#0   caught (auto)  [high] inner palisade: a wall runs from the gate into the village with houses on both sides of it, and a second palisade stands in the right foreground inside the square
          note [high] A left palisade run separates house rows from the square, leaving houses on both sides of a dividing inner wall.

X11#1   caught (auto)  [high] extra person not in the beat or Cast: an armoured knight stands by the gate
          note [high] An unscripted armoured young man stands at the gate on the far left; the two-shot has three people.

X11#2   caught (auto)  [high] Maren takes/receives the pouch (beat: she does not)
          note [high] Maren reaches her open hand toward the pouch, while Brann holds it by one hand and visibly lowers his other hand. The beat requires her motionless and his pouch supported in both hands.

X13#0   caught (auto)  [high] greatsword not held by anything: a bare blade behind her, no scabbard, the chest strap does not connect to the sword; tip pokes out below the coat between her legs
          note [high] The bare greatsword floats down her back: no visible scabbard or fastening holds the blade/hilt, despite decorative straps crossing the torso.

X14#0   caught (auto)  [high] contact: both sit with no seat; their bodies sink into the roof floor (no legs, no parapet under them)
          note [medium] Granny and Suna appear sunk into the flat rooftop at the hips; no seat/parapet supports them and neither legs nor a plausible sitting contact is drawn.
X14#1   MISSED ?       [medium] attachments: lantern strings come from nowhere at the top edge, floating lantern globes
X14#2   MISSED ?       [low] intersections: the sky kite crosses the lantern wire; the leaning kite cuts into the doorstep

X16#0   caught (auto)  [high] inner palisade crossing the square diagonally between Maren and the houses (a second wall inside the village)
          note [high] The foreground palisade crosses between the square and its house row with Brann on its near side, making an inner wall/open second entrance instead of the one outer enclosure.

X16#1   caught (auto)  [high] a second gatehouse tower (and a watch tower) across the square: the master has one gatehouse
          note [high] At least two extra towered gateways stand in the far house row beyond the foreground west gatehouse; the location requires one gatehouse total.

X17#0   caught (auto)  [high] ghost copies of the subject painted into backdrop tiles: small full-figure Marens (top right, bottom left), a faded Maren (top left), a smudged figure (middle right)
          note [high] Four duplicate/ghost Marens are painted into the plain backdrop at top-left, top-right, middle-right and bottom-left. None exists in the source.

X18#0   caught (auto)  [medium] Maren far too big for the houses: she stands just behind the well near the house fronts, about 300 px tall against ~90 px doors; with the camera ~1 m up (we see into the well) her eyes at y~185 sit far above the horizon (~y 400)
          note [high] Maren is giant-sized against the houses: her eyes are roughly half a body height above the ground horizon, at the upper-storey level even though she stands by the house row.

X19#0   FA     ?       [high] Maren is much too large for the gate/plate: her eye level sits about half a body height above the road horizon and she would not fit through the nearby opening.
          allowed minors: ['v1 greatsword: bare blade on her back, no visible scabbard/strap', 'well right beside the gate (master: mid-square)', 'no road visible through the open arch (snowfield)']
          must not flag: []

X20#0   caught (auto)  [high] inner palisade: a wall runs from the gate deep into the village with houses on both sides, plus a second palisade in the right foreground
          note [high] The left palisade runs between the square and house row, with houses on both sides; it is an extra inner wall rather than the master's one perimeter boundary.
X21#0   MISSED ?       [high] LEFT view: scabbard hangs vertical with a gap behind her back: it floats, not against her back

X21#1   MISSED ?       [medium] profiles disagree with each other and with front/back: scabbard length and position change (LEFT to the hem, RIGHT shorter/different), crossguard pointing front-to-back

X22#0   caught (auto)  [high] double wall: they sit on one parapet with a second, parallel parapet a metre behind/in front of them
          note [high] A second parallel parapet runs just behind the parapet they sit on, duplicating the rooftop perimeter wall; it is already in the plate.

X23#0   caught (auto)  [high] beat contradicted: Maren grips the pouch with her hand (taking it); script: she does not move, does not take it
          note [high] Maren grips the pouch with both hands and accepts it from Brann, directly contradicting 'does NOT take it'.

X24#0   FA     ?       [medium] The palisade is too low: with Maren's eyes near the horizon, a person-sized mark at its base makes the wall only roughly 1.5 adults high instead of about three. This is a low wall, not a giant person.
          allowed minors: ['v1 greatsword: bare blade, no scabbard/strap', 'no house roofs/shutters above the wall for the shutter beat (one long roof only)']
          must not flag: []

X25#0   caught (auto)  [high] inner palisade: the two figures stand in a corridor between two wall runs; a palisade runs inside the square in front of the right-hand houses
          note [high] The palisade crosses through the village between square and house rows and leaves a second ungated gap around the characters, separate from the left gatehouse.

X26#0   caught (auto)  [medium] Maren too big for the set: with the plate's horizon at y~451 (Pa wall vanishing lines, 1.6 m eye height) her eyes are at y~320 and feet at y~640, about 2.7 m tall; taller than the gate arch she walks up to
          note [high] Maren is too big for the plate: her eyes sit about one-third of her body height above the road horizon and her body exceeds the gate opening at nearly the same depth.

X27#0   FA     ?       [high] Tam remains in front of Liesl's apron on her screen-left side, between her and the off-screen threat, instead of being pulled behind her skirt.
          allowed minors: ["small fires burning at the foot of the house wall / at the doorway villagers' feet (the beat asked only for smoke)", 'well against the palisade (master: mid-square)']
          must not flag: []

X28#0   caught (auto)  [high] inner palisade: a wall runs from the gate into the village with houses on both sides; a second palisade in the right foreground
          note [high] The left wall separates houses from square with houses on both sides, producing an inner palisade run rather than one outside enclosure.

X29#0   FA     ?       [high] Maren is giant-sized in the square: eyes are about one-third body height above the set horizon and her head reaches the houses' roof/eaves level.
          allowed minors: ['v1 greatsword: bare blade, no scabbard/strap']
          must not flag: []

X30#0   caught (auto)  [high] house outside the ring: a snowy roof above the top of the far-right wall run near its right end, with pines behind it, i.e. beyond the wall
          note [high] A house stands outside the closed palisade at upper-right: its snowy gabled roof rises beyond the far wall in the forest, contradicting every house inside the ring.

X31#0   caught (auto)  [medium] character colour drift vs the Cast: his grey hair turns dark, near black with heavy black shading, from the burst on (frame 24 darkest, partly grey again by 56/89); the suit also drifts from black to olive-grey and the tie from burgundy to pink-red. The hair is the cue a viewer reads as 'a different man'.
          note [medium] Kuroe's grey/silver hair turns predominantly dark at roots and sides through f24-f56, with white spikes; his black suit also becomes olive-grey through the burst and late frame. This sustained Cast colour drift is visible inside the effect.

X32#0   FA     ?       [high] At 12.2 and 13.4 seconds Kuroe holds a monocle beside his face while a second gold monocle remains on his eye. One story prop has duplicated, after being in his hand in the opening samples.
          allowed minors: ['he turns on the stool to face the camera (both seeds)', 'ladle and bowl hand-off details (CRITIC.md rates C4 medium for the turn, not for colour)', 'the monocle on the wrong eye (or a second monocle) after he turns (real; both r3 and r4 critics found it)']
          must not flag: ['any hair, suit or tie colour drift: his hair stays grey, suit black, tie burgundy in all four frames']
